conditions: Cite BIS and the applicable national source when statistics are reproduced. | The committed repository stores coverage evidence and hashes, not the raw bulk file. | Observed rates are compiled reference rates, not executable broker quotes. | BIS values are currency units per USD; Phase 02 must invert causally to USD per currency. | A conservative availability lag is required because the bulk file is updated weekly.

All nine non-USD G10 legs are listed in the H.10 historical country tables. | The common electronic history begins in 2000. | Rates are noon buying rates or comparable reference observations, not executable quotes. | Raw redistribution terms require a final legal review before mirroring data.

Historical bid and ask prices are available and can measure the observed spread. | The published overnight policy is dynamic and does not expose a verified historical swap-rate series. | Historical commission, raw-data redistribution, and exact account-tier mechanics remain unresolved.

Bid, ask, and midpoint candles are documented but API access requires an account token. | The API exposes current financing parameters, not a verified public historical financing series. | A public, credential-free reproduction path is unavailable.

Listed futures are the conceptually preferred implementation because carry is embedded and rolls are explicit. | The audit did not verify credential-free bulk history, redistribution rights, or liquid continuous coverage for all nine legs. | Free current bulletins do not by themselves establish a reproducible 2000-2026 contract archive.

Policy-rate differentials are not realized forward points or broker swap debits and credits. | The proxy omits cross-currency basis, tenor conventions, and broker markup. | Policy-rate coverage was not downloaded in this phase; the stack remains under review. | It may be a diagnostic feature but cannot satisfy the total-return contract.
